title: OCDocker: molecular docking automation, virtual screening and AI consensus scoring
description:
OCDocker integrates the stages of a virtual-screening campaign that are usually fragmented across independent tools — molecular preparation, docking with multiple engines (AutoDock Vina, Smina, PLANTS, GNINA), automated pose selection, rescoring, descriptor extraction and machine-learning training — into a single configurable, traceable workflow, in which an ablation is a configuration change rather than a reimplementation.

It also implements OCScore, a consensus score that combines classical scoring functions with ligand and receptor descriptors, together with an ablation framework, statistical comparison (paired t-test with Holm-Bonferroni correction) and a SHAP-based shortcut-risk analysis for auditing what a learned score actually relies on.

Source code, ablation protocols and the scripts that reproduce the figures of the associated manuscript are included.

Software registration. OCDocker is registered as a computer program with the INPI (Instituto Nacional da Propriedade Industrial, Brazil) under BR 512025007028-4, granted on 22 December 2025, in the name of the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ), Artur Duque Rossi and Pedro Henrique Monteiro Torres.
